Usage guide

Approved use

Use the dark logo on white or light-coloured backgrounds.

Use the light (inverted) logo on dark or coloured backgrounds.

Use SVG at any scale — it remains sharp at all sizes.

Maintain clear space equal to the wordmark cap-height on all sides.

Prohibited use

Do not recolour, tint, or apply effects to the logo.

Do not place an outline or drop shadow around the logo.

Do not stretch, compress, skew, or rotate the logo.

Do not scale the icon and wordmark independently.

Do not place the logo on a busy or low-contrast background.

Usage guide

Approved use

Dark icon on white or light backgrounds.

Light icon on dark or coloured backgrounds.

Light icon on the Electric Blue (#3688FF) brand background.

Use in place of the full logo only when context makes the brand clear (e.g. favicon, avatar).

Prohibited use

Do not recolour or apply gradients to the icon.

Do not warp, rotate, or distort the icon.

Do not use the icon in isolation in marketing material where the full logo should appear.

Do not combine the icon with a different wordmark.

Nomenclature

Name usage

When referring to the project in text, use ThunderID — one word, capital T and capital ID.

Correct

ThunderID

Incorrect

Thunder ID

Thunderid

thunderid

Thunder-ID

Do not use “ThunderID” in your own product or service name in a way that implies an official relationship.

Questions about brand use?

For permission requests, open a discussion on GitHub.
